contract: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"5 <= n <= 200000","description":"The number of cities n must be between 5 and 200,000."},{"id":"P2","expression":"all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in roads)","description":"Each road must connect two distinct cities within the range of 1 to n."},{"id":"P3","expression":"1 <= t <= 200000","description":"The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 200,000."},{"id":"P4","expression":"all(1 <= uj <= n and 1 <= vj <= n and 1 <= xj <= n and 1 <= yj <= n and uj != vj and xj != yj for uj, vj, xj, yj in test_cases)","description":"Each test case must specify valid and distinct cities within the range of 1 to n."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == '0' if uj == xj and vj == yj else stdout != '0'","description":"If JH and JY start at the same cities, they meet immediately, otherwise, the output is not zero."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"stdout == '-1' if not any(meeting_time > 0 for meeting_time in meeting_times) else stdout != '-1'","description":"If no valid meeting time is found, output -1, otherwise, output a valid meeting time."},{"id":"Q3","expression":"all(isinstance(meeting_time, int) and meeting_time >= 0 for meeting_time in meeting_times)","description
